texts.name: Bella
texts.biography: Bella was born out of a female engineer with a passion for mechanical design. She was designed in the likeness of this engineer and became a clone of her. However, her mind one day overcame her master. Since then, she has abandoned the bionic shell her master once gave her.

specialty.description: Increases Speed of any Technicians or Engineers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for 4 levels (rounded up).
specialty.name: Technicians
